description: Create a one-off payment invoice; the payer opens result.mini_app_invoice_url. See the invoices doc.

accepted_assets.description: Fiat mode: comma-separated assets the payer may pay in.

amount.description: Decimal string in MAJOR units, e.g. "5" = 5 USDT. Never a float. Omit for an open-amount invoice.

hidden_message.description: Revealed to the payer ONLY after payment (≤2048).

payload.description: Opaque data echoed back in the webhook (≤4096).

rate_lock_seconds.description: Fiat mode: freeze crypto quotes for this long.

swap_to.description: Auto-convert the received amount to this asset.

name: createInvoice
